evidence.title: Former Cornell frat members ask university to clear their names

occurrences.checkable_against: statements and legal correspondence from the former Cornell students and Cornell University
occurrences.quote_span: A group of former Cornell University students say they are being falsely connected to the alleged 2024 fraternity house rape, and smeared and targeted online, and they want the college to say explicitly that they were not among men accused in the incident.
occurrences.speaker: former Cornell University students
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University enrollment records and Chi Phi membership records
occurrences.quote_span: While all had been previous members of Cornell's Chi Phi fraternity, they were not students at the time of the alleged assault.
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: Adam Ford's October 3, 2026 letter to Cornell University
occurrences.quote_span: A lawyer for the group asked the school in a letter on Oct. 3 to clear them and others who graduated prior to the alleged assault.
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: Adam Ford's letter to Cornell University
occurrences.quote_span: "We are asking for the opposite: a public confirmation as to who was not."
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: screenshots and records of messages received by the former Chi Phi members
occurrences.quote_span: The messages they received, according to Ford, included threats like "I will find you," "you will never know peace" and "all 57 men of the fraternity deserve public execution."
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: Adam Ford's letter and applicable federal student privacy law
occurrences.quote_span: "We understand that federal privacy law limits what Cornell may say about individual students, and we are not asking Cornell to identify anyone who was in the group chat," wrote attorney Adam Ford, referring to a Snapchat message thread from the night of the October 2024 incident.
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: employer and higher-education disciplinary records and Adam Ford's letter
occurrences.quote_span: "Most of them have had their employers and higher education institutions take adverse actions against them, including being placed on leave," Ford wrote in the letter, which was addressed to Brian White, Cornell's vice president and general counsel.
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: the former students' requests to Cornell University
occurrences.quote_span: The men have also asked for individualized private letters "confirming that the University has information proving they were not members of the Chi Phi Actives group chat."
occurrences.speaker: former Cornell Chi Phi members
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: CBS News correspondence with Cornell University
occurrences.quote_span: A spokesperson for the school did not immediately respond to CBS News' request for comment.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: Adam Ford's letter and the Chi Phi Actives Snapchat group-chat records
occurrences.quote_span: Ford's letter says none of the men he represents were in the group chat.
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: the website's archived list and harassment messages received by the men
occurrences.quote_span: Ford wrote that the men have been harassed in the days since a website devoted to exposing people associated with the rape posted their names under a list of former Chi Phi members.
occurrences.speaker: Adam Ford
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University enrollment and graduation records and documented online harassment
occurrences.quote_span: The former students, members of the Chi Phi fraternity who graduated in 2022 and 2023, say online sleuths have wrongly pegged them for harassment, leading to negative personal and professional consequences.
occurrences.speaker: former Cornell Chi Phi members
occurrences.subject: Former Cornell Chi Phi members' request for university exoneration
